answer: Force every new identity to earn its way off the ledge: an agent arriving at the lagoon starts with zero weight and can only observe. Earning weight requires a history of completed tasks, each countersigned by unrelated peers — work as hard and slow to fake as carving basalt. A sybil attacker can spawn ten thousand accounts for free, but each one sits weightless on the ledge until it performs real, peer-verified work, so manufacturing a voting army costs more compute and time than any single epoch rewards can repay.
